thingsToDo.title: The Clark Fork Riverfront Trail
thingsToDo.description: the Clark Fork Riverfront Trail is one of the easiest ways to understand Missoula. Plan about one to two hours, then pair it with a nearby cafe, neighborhood walk, or guided outing. This stop adds a recognizable anchor to your Missoula itinerary without forcing extra travel time.

faq.a: Two to three days is enough for core Missoula highlights plus one or two local experiences.
